manifest.author: Sean Galliher and Cowork Cookbook contributors
manifest.description: Builds an interactive HTML analyst briefing dashboard (positioning, top three messages, anticipated Q&A, speaker notes, source links) from prior firm interactions, their research, and your launch materials, then schedule
manifest.display_name: Analyst briefing prep and rehearsal routing
manifest.name: @cowork-cookbook/analyst_briefing_prep_and_rehearsal_routing

details.license_note: Recipe content is CC BY 4.0 (share and adapt with attribution) and code is MIT. RAR carries each recipe's prompt, prerequisites, steps and expected output verbatim with attribution, so the toasted agent runs the real recipe; bundles and screenshots stay upstream.

analyst_firm.description: Name of the analyst firm being briefed.

briefing_date.description: Date of the analyst briefing; rehearsal is set 48 hours prior.

context.description: Optional. Details the recipe should use — the record, scope, dates or filters it asks for.

operation.description: What to do: run, prompt, plan, checklist, describe.

people.description: Speaker name for speaker notes, plus spokesperson and briefing owner for the rehearsal invite.

product_area_and_launch.description: Product area for their published research and the product/launch materials to cross-reference.

source_locations.description: OneDrive folder with launch materials and the approved messaging doc.
